_comment: Tracked deprecations awaiting removal. The deprecation-reaper workflow reads this file weekly, looks up when each entry's PR merged (its exact mergedAt timestamp), and once mergedAt + grace has elapsed it opens/refreshes a tracking issue and pings the owners. Entries whose PR is not merged yet are ignored, so the clock only starts at merge. Remove an entry once its functions are deleted.

deprecations.description: Legacy transpose compute API (transpose_wh_init / transpose_wh_init_short / transpose_wh_tile) deprecated in favor of compute_kernel_hw_startup() + transpose_init() / transpose_tile() in api/compute/transpose.h. Delete the whole api/compute/transpose_wh.h shim once all call sites are migrated.

Legacy in-DST transpose compute API (transpose_wh_dest_init_short / transpose_wh_dest) deprecated in favor of transpose_dest_init() / transpose_dest() in api/compute/transpose_dest.h. Delete the whole api/compute/transpose_wh_dest.h shim once all call sites are migrated.

Legacy eltwise binary init API in tt_metal/hw/inc/api/compute/eltwise_binary.h: binary_op_init_common, add_tiles_init, sub_tiles_init, mul_tiles_init (both overloads), binary_dest_reuse_tiles_init, and binary_dest_reuse_tiles. Replaced by compute_kernel_hw_startup() once at kernel start + the per-op add_init/sub_init/mul_init API. The dest-reuse path (one operand taken from DST) is the per-op {add,sub,mul}_reuse_dest_init<reuse_dest> init paired with {add,sub,mul}_reuse_dest_tiles<reuse_dest> execute. Also covers the broadcast inits in bcast.h: the binary init_bcast and add/sub/mul_bcast_{rows,cols,scalar}_init_short (replaced by compute_kernel_hw_startup() + bcast_init<OP,DIM> / {op}_bcast_{dim}_init), the unary full init unary_bcast_init(icb, ocb) (replaced by compute_kernel_hw_startup(icb, ocb) + the 1-arg unary_bcast_init(icb)), and the bespoke reconfigure_unary_bcast (replaced by generic reconfig_data_format_srca/_srcb + pack_reconfig_data_format + unary_bcast_init(icb)). All deprecated shims usable until September 15th, 2026; remove once all call sites are migrated.

pack_tile_block in tt_metal/hw/inc/api/compute/pack.h renamed to pack_block for a uniform op_block Compute API surface (tt-metal#47477). The pack_tile_block forwarding shim is retained only for backwards compatibility; delete it once all call sites are migrated to pack_block.

copy_block_matmul_partials in tt_metal/hw/inc/api/compute/tile_move_copy.h superseded by the uniform copy_block (functionally equivalent; same block unpack/datacopy paths) as part of the op_block Compute API surface (tt-metal#47477). The copy_block_matmul_partials forwarding shim is retained only for backwards compatibility; delete it once all call sites are migrated to copy_block.

The reconfig_data_format / reconfig_data_format_srca / reconfig_data_format_srcb overloads that take <to_from_int8, is_tile_dim_reconfig_en> are deprecated (tt-metal#34499). int8/unsigned state is now always derived from the format (to_from_int8 is ignored, closing a latent stale-bit bug), and the two-source form gained a SrcOrder tag (added as a same-name overload; an explicit <bool, ...> call still selects the deprecated bool overloads by type) so matmul stops swapping operands by hand. In-repo call sites are already migrated to the current API (reconfig_data_format<SrcOrder>() and reconfig_data_format_skip_int8()); these deprecated bool overloads remain only for external callers during the grace period. The cleanup PR deletes them and the now-vestigial to_from_int8 flag.

Legacy copy / eltwise-unary init API: copy_tile_init, copy_tile_to_dst_init_short, copy_tile_to_dst_init_short_with_dt in tt_metal/hw/inc/api/compute/tile_move_copy.h and unary_op_init_common, init_sfpu in tt_metal/hw/inc/api/compute/eltwise_unary/eltwise_unary.h. Replaced by compute_kernel_hw_startup(icb, ocb) + copy_init(icb); data-format reconfiguration via reconfig_data_format_srca. Deprecation messages state a fixed removal date of September 20th, 2026.

The Runtime API entry points that identify a command queue by raw id are deprecated in favor of overloads taking MeshCommandQueue& (tt-metal#51559): BeginTraceCapture(MeshDevice*, uint8_t) -> MeshDevice::begin_mesh_trace(MeshCommandQueue&), Synchronize(MeshDevice*, std::optional<uint8_t>, ...) -> Synchronize(MeshDevice&, ttsl::optional_reference<MeshCommandQueue>, ...), MeshDevice::{begin,end,replay}_mesh_trace(uint8_t, ...) -> the same members taking MeshCommandQueue&, and MeshEvent(uint32_t, MeshDevice*, uint32_t, const MeshCoordinateRange&) -> MeshEvent(uint32_t, MeshCommandQueue&, const MeshCoordinateRange&). All in-repo call sites are already migrated; the id-based overloads remain only for external callers during the grace period. The cleanup PR deletes them and their definitions in distributed.cpp, mesh_device.cpp and mesh_event.cpp, leaving only the MeshCommandQueue& forms.

The is_tile_dim_reconfig_en template bool on reconfig_data_format / _srca / _srcb (and the _skip_int8 forms) is replaced by intent-named entry points (tt-metal#34499, closes tt-metal#47382): reconfig_data_format() is now format + tile size only (geometry off), reconfig_full_operand() adds tile/face geometry (what <..., true> did), and reconfig_tile_shape() reprograms tile size + geometry only (no format; a genuine unpack-side split). reconfig_full_operand and reconfig_tile_shape are Wormhole/Blackhole only -- on Quasar tile geometry is programmed at op init, so those APIs are not defined there. The deprecated <SrcOrder, is_tile_dim_reconfig_en> overloads (including the _skip_int8 forms) preserve today's exact behavior and are disambiguated from the older <to_from_int8, is_tile_dim_reconfig_en> bool overloads by first template arg type. All in-repo call sites are migrated to reconfig_full_operand*(); these deprecated overloads remain only for external callers during the grace period. The cleanup PR removes them.
